rows.label: tlk70000121_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Is it true you're trying to stop that
monster called Heaven's Holy Grail?

rows.label: tlk70000121_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Heartless people made me unhappy,
but Heaven's Holy Grail must be making
many others unhappy too.

rows.label: tlk70000121_05_msg0003
rows.name:
So please defeat it, so no more
children ever end up in circumstances
like mine...

rows.label: tlk70000121_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Don't worry, I'm not
causing trouble any more.

rows.label: tlk70000121_05_msg0005
rows.name:
I'm going round the camps in Gula
and looking for survivors from the
villages that have been attacked.

rows.label: tlk70000121_05_msg0006
rows.name: See you. I'm counting on you!
